_about: Verified official addresses of brands and bodies that scammers imitate most in India. Single source of truth for the link checker (sach/linkcheck.py). Every domain has an evidence URL and the date it was checked. A domain is listed only if an official page confirms it: the brand's own site redirecting to or linking it, or a regulator/government page that links it. Anything that could not be confirmed is NOT here (see docs/link-checker.md, 'Dropped'). To add one: see docs/link-checker.md.
